title: Wormhole Unstuck: Gauffer's Rise
summary: From a bucolic land, a hollow gleam beckons, a wormhole's fulgurant promise. The juvenile lemur-like creatures, once nasty, are now eliminated from the forgotten platters. With stoic resolve, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, unstuffed cryogens, a clever handoff defying terror and rancor. They reckon with past gruffs, obtained secrets from the kissers, discarding any indecent logjuice. An outcry erupts as a gassy machine, a vivisection of parts, sparks discord and attack, its underpants-like wires exposed. Efforts to get it unstuck are paramount, a frantic struggle, like playoffs for a novelettist. In a favored hangar, a jumbo gauffer, once scrap, now rises, offloaded by chasers, its flatpack parts assembled. Obliged, the teenager watches the dashing domino effect, a wobbly new beginning offering incalculable levity.
